macros.name: asyfig
macros.doc: This suite of packages provides an alternate method of including standalone Aymptote figures within LaTeX documents via the \asyfig command.

macros.name: asypath
macros.doc: If all of your .asy files take a common path prefix (such as ./figures/asy/), this can be defined with the \asypath{⟨path⟩} command.
